## [0.0.21](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram/compare/v0.0.20...v0.0.21) (2026-11-18)

### Features

* A saved profile can sit in more than one folder now. Save profile lists your folders with tick boxes, and a long press in `Your saved profiles` offers `Choose folders`. Settings exports keep every folder. Asked for in #687.
* `Long press a profile picture to view it`, new under Profiles, opens the picture at the top of a profile at full size, with Save under it. A tap still does what it always did. Starts off. Asked for in #737.
* `Download full song`, new under Reels, adds a row under Download on reels and photos with Instagram music. It saves the whole song instead of the reel's clip, and `Ask what to save` offers it too. Starts off. Asked for in #735.
* `Hide the top bar on other reels`, new under Reels, takes the back arrow and title off reels you open from Explore, a profile, a post, Saved or a chat. The back gesture still works. Starts off. Asked for in #680.
* `Search blocked accounts`, new under Ads and privacy, adds a search box to your blocked accounts that finds them by username or name. Long lists load as you type, with a count of matches. Starts off. Asked for in #731.
* `Hide the Messages badge`, new under Tab bar, takes the unread count off the Messages button in the bottom bar. Chats still show as unread in your inbox and notifications still come. It starts off and takes a restart. Asked for in #734.
* `Don't send feed view history`, new under Feed, stops Instagram from learning which Home posts you looked at, like `Don't send reel watch history` does for Reels. Seen posts may come back. Ghost mode turns it on too. Starts off. Asked for in #664.
* `Ask for VP9 instead of AV1`, new under Downloads, tells Instagram your phone has no AV1 decoder, so reels and stories come as VP9 or H.264. It helps when AV1 saves won't play in your gallery. Asked for in #546.
* `Keep story viewers`, new under Stories, keeps a list on your phone of who viewed each of your stories. Its page shows who viewed over a week, month or 90 days and who views most. Asked for in #710.
* `Keep online history`, new under Profiles, keeps a list on your phone of when people in your messages came online and went offline, from the active status Instagram already shows. Asked for in #590.
* `Glass lens under your finger`, new in Tab bar, makes the `Liquid glass look` bubble swell and bend what's behind it under your finger. The bend needs `Blur behind the tab bar` and Android 13 or newer. Starts off. Asked for in #705.
* `Cache size limit`, a slider under `Clear the media cache` in Storage, sets how much room Instagram's saved photos and videos can take, from 100 MB to 4,000 MB. It starts at 500 MB like before. Asked for in #713.
* `Save changed pictures to the gallery`, under `Keep profile history` in Profiles, saves both the old and the new picture when a profile you open has changed it. Each picture is saved once. Starts off. Asked for in #715.
* Tap the `Show it as a chip` chip on a profile to see everything else Instagram says about you two, like a pending follow request, Close Friends, Favorites, a restriction, a block, a hidden story or a mute. Asked for in #698.
* `Tabs on your profile` and `Tabs on other profiles` under Profiles can take a creator's Subscriptions tab off too, along with Reels, Reposts and Tagged. Asked for in #721.
* `Hide rings outside the stories row`, under `Story ring size` in Stories, takes the story and live rings off profile pictures on posts, comments, reels and profiles. The pictures stay, and so do the rings in the stories row. Asked for in #719.
* Each number beside a reel can go on its own now. Five new switches under Reels, `Hide like counts on reels` through `Hide save counts on reels`, each take one count away and leave its button. Asked for in #719.
* `Material look`, under Glass tab bar in Tab bar, gives the floating tab bar Android's Material 3 style, a solid round pill in your phone's colors on Android 12 and newer. It needs `Liquid glass look` off. Asked for in #720.
* `Start feed videos muted`, under Feed, keeps videos on Home quiet even after you turn the sound on in Reels, so reels keep theirs. Tap a video's speaker to hear that one. Asked for in #718.
* `Double tap to skip` on Reels flashes arrows and the seconds skipped on the side you tapped, like it already does on feed videos. `Show the skip arrows`, right under it, turns them off. Asked for in #691.
* Quick double taps the same way now add up under the skip arrows on Reels and feed videos, so three skips ahead read 10, 20 and then 30. Asked for in #554.
* `Hide the seek bar on reels`, new under Reels, takes the seek bar off every reel. Drag sideways along a reel's bottom edge to bring it back and seek, even where Instagram turns that off. Needs a restart. Asked for in #680.
* `Hide the pause icon on reels` under Reels keeps a paused reel clear of the big pause icon and its sound button, so the frame you stopped on stays in view. A tap still plays it. Asked for in #686.
* `Hide the Like button on reels` and `Hide the Comment button on reels` under Reels, and `Hide the Like button` under Feed, take those buttons and their counts away. Double tap still likes. Asked for in #668.
* `Ask before a refresh` also asks when you tap Home, Reels or Explore while you're already on it, since that tap scrolls back to the top and reloads too. Cancel leaves the list where it was. Asked for in #655.
* HushGram's own settings screen uses the font you pick in `Change the font` too, headings and switch labels included. Its popups follow it as well, like the "i" descriptions, pickers and PIN prompts. Asked for in #166.
* HushGram speaks Simplified Chinese. Phones set to Simplified Chinese, or to Chinese for China or Singapore, get it instead of English. It's built from the Traditional Chinese table and uses Instagram's own mainland names, like 快拍 and 帖子. Asked for in #659.
* `Double-tap Messages for hidden chats` now shows your hidden chats right in your inbox after your screen lock or PIN, and two more quick taps on Messages hide them again. Long press a chat for Hide chat or Unhide chat. Asked for in #661.
* A new switch, `Hide You may also like in search` under Explore, takes the You may also like posts and their title off the bottom of search results. Accounts and the posts you searched for stay. Asked for in #657.
* `Play only the reel you opened` under Reels keeps a reel you open from a Home post, a suggested reels row or a message on screen, so it loops instead of moving on. The Reels tab scrolls as usual. Asked for in #656.
* `Glass top bar in chats`, new under `Glass in chats` in Messages, takes the frosted band off a chat's top bar while the round glass buttons and message bar keep theirs. It starts on. Asked for in #670.
* `Auto scroll in Home` under Feed moves Home to the next post by itself, when a video ends or after the time you pick for photos and carousels. Touching the screen holds it. Asked for in #660.
* A new switch, `Control the reel above comments` under Reels, lets you tap the reel above open comments to pause or play it, or hold it for 2x. The comments stay open. Starts off. Asked for in #665.
* A new switch, `Classic colors` under Layout, turns dark mode navy blue with charcoal gray panels and light mode off-white, the Messages list included, like Instagram's older look. Story and reel viewers keep their own. Asked for in #639.
* `Swipe left for Messages`, new under Feed, opens Messages when you swipe left across Home, the way Instagram used to. Carousels and the stories row still slide as before. It starts off. Asked for in #639.
* `Hide links`, new with the other profile banner switches under Profiles, takes the row of links (a website or a business's links) from under the bio on other people's profiles. Yours keeps it. Asked for in #627.
* `Send saved GIFs as GIFs`, new under Comments, posts a GIF you saved with `Save comment photo` as a GIF when you pick it from your gallery in a comment. Instagram sent it as a still. Asked for in #402.
* `Hide Blend in chats` and `Hide the back button in chats`, new under Messages, take those buttons off a chat's top bar. Swiping back still leaves the chat. Asked for in #688.
* `Top bar tint in chats` and `Message bar tint`, new under `Glass in chats`, set how dark each glass bar is, from 0% (blur only) to 150%. The tab bar keeps its own tint. Asked for in #688.
* `Header text font` picks bold, regular, serif, script, monospace or your `Font` choice for the words on Home's header, and `Center the header text` puts them in the middle of the screen. Asked for in #688.
* With `Glass in chats` on, messages scroll under a chat's top bar and show through it blurred, and the blur runs up behind the status bar with a soft fade at its edge. Asked for in #684.
* `Story buttons at the bottom`, new under Stories, puts the seen and download buttons at the bottom right of a story, by your thumb, next to Like. Asked for in #647.
* `Text size`, new under `Font`, sets Instagram's text anywhere from 70% to 200% of the phone's size, in any font. Asked for in #682.
* `Profile history` keeps each profile picture at full size. Old pictures open full screen from its page, a long press saves one to your gallery, and every row says when its old value was seen. Asked for in #611.
* `Decline calls that don't ring`, new under Call blocker, declines a call `Who can call you` keeps quiet, the same as tapping Decline, so it doesn't keep ringing on their end. Starts off. Asked for in #578.
* `Locked collections` under Messages locks single collections in Saved with the same unlock as your other locks. The rest of Saved stays open, and saving a post to a locked one never asks. Asked for in #678.
* `Sort reels on profiles`, new under Profiles, puts the arrow next to Reels on every profile so you can sort by Latest or Most viewed where Instagram took that away. Starts off. Asked for in #679.
* `Shorter Active now`, new under Messages, drops Active now a minute after someone leaves, like the website, instead of six and a half minutes. Restart Instagram after turning it on. Starts off. Asked for in #683.
* `Sent follow requests`, new under Profiles, keeps a list of the accounts you've asked to follow that haven't let you in. Tap one to open the profile, where Instagram's Requested button cancels it. Starts off. Asked for in #690.
* With `Glass tab bar` on, a reel's seek bar keeps a little room above the tab bar instead of sitting right on it. The caption and buttons move up with it. Asked for in #187.
* `Hide the speed lock message`, under `Hide the 2x popup` in Reels, keeps Instagram's Locked at 2x speed message off a reel, and the one when the lock ends. The lock still works. Starts off. Asked for in #702 and #552.
* `Remove hidden data from saved photos`, new under Downloads, strips Meta's FBMD tracking tag and camera, place or time details from photos you save. It and `Add the source to saved photos and videos` now go into settings backups. Asked for in #699.
* `Show the skip arrows` now sits under `Double tap to skip on feed videos` in Feed as well. Turn it off and a double tap still skips, with nothing flashing over the video. Asked for in #562.
* `Feed seek bar shape`, under `Seek bar shape` in Feed, gives feed videos their own shape, so the feed can use the thin line while reels and stories keep theirs. Starts on `Same as Seek bar shape`. Asked for in #567.
* `Time on the seek bar` in Feed shows the time played and the length over a feed video's seek bar, like 0:12 / 0:45. Tap it, or turn on `Show the time left`, to count down instead. Starts off. Asked for in #711.
* `Taps on feed videos stay in the feed`, under `Tap a feed video to pause it` in Feed, stops a tap on a feed video, or on a finished one's end screen, from opening it in Reels. Starts off. Asked for in #706.
* `Items in the three-dot menus` in Feed lets you untick Report, Mute, Unfollow, Not interested, Interested, Why you're seeing this post and the playback rows to drop them from the menus. Stories lose Report and Mute too. Asked for in #697 and #707.
* `Keep 2x after you let go`, under `Hold for 2x on feed videos` in Feed, keeps a held feed video at 2x after you lift your finger. Hold and let go again for normal speed. Starts off. Asked for in #552.
* `Ring thickness`, new under `Story ring size` in Stories, draws story rings thinner or thicker, from 50% to 200% of Instagram's width. The size and color lists above it work the same as before. Asked for in #528.
* `Ring color` has a Custom choice now. Type a hex color in `Custom ring color` for one solid color, and another in `Custom ring end color` to fade between the two. Saving one picks Custom for you. Asked for in #696.
* On a photo story with music, the Download button at the top of the story asks whether you want the video or the photo, like the three-dot menu already does. Asked for in #726.
* `Hide stories in Reels`, new under Reels right below `Hide suggested accounts`, leaves out the Catch up with friends pages of stories that Instagram drops between reels. Your stories row on Home stays. Starts off. Asked for in #730.

### Bug Fixes

* With `Double tap to skip` on, a side double tap on a short reel jumps to its start or end instead of liking it. A double tap in the middle still likes. Found while testing #554.
* Two photos saved in the same second both end up in your gallery now. They got the same file name, so the second one replaced the first. Found while checking #715.
* With `Keep clear mode on`, the next reel no longer flashes its buttons after a swipe. The top bar stays hidden through the swipe too, and leaving clear mode brings the buttons back. Reported in #740.
* With `Only received reels` on, a reel you just sent stays out when you swipe through a chat's reels. Your own new messages no longer set off the `Messages after a reel` banner either. Reported in #738.
* With `Glass in chats` on, messages scroll behind the whole message bar, so it's see-through instead of black at the bottom. With a bigger `Text size`, the camera and + buttons stay inside the bar's round ends. Reported in #729.
* Long press a chat in your messages and its menu opens right at that chat, under your finger or above it when there's no room. It used to drop to the bottom, over the tab bar. Reported in #728.
* `Keep playing in the background` shows its notification on a Root Mount install too, with Pause, Play and Stop. Before, the video kept playing with no notification and no way to stop it short of reopening Instagram. Reported in #349.
* Picking friends on the Friends tab in Reels now leaves the other reels out. Before, one reel from each page without your picks still showed between theirs, so the tab barely looked filtered. Reported in #503.
* `Accent color` reads Instagram's button colors a second way now, for phones whose Android stores them a little differently, like ColorOS 17 on Oppo. There, Follow and other buttons kept Instagram's blue. Reported in #727.
* Reels opened from Explore or search now fit their button column under the top bar too. Only the Reels tab got the fit before, so with several HushGram icons on, Like ran off the top of the screen there. Reported in #516.
* With `Glass tab bar` and `Hide the tab bar on Reels`, a reel's caption, buttons and seek bar follow the pill down when it slides away. They used to stay up and leave an empty strip below. Reported in #736.
* Holding the Friends tab no longer says there are no friends to pick when the tab already shows their reels. The list fills from what the tab shows and keeps them after Instagram closes. Reported in #503.
* In Turkish, German, Spanish and Portuguese, the seek bar rows called it a search bar. They now use the same word as `Keep a seek bar` in each language. Reported in #10.
* In Simplified Chinese, `Clear saved copies now` says it freed the space instead of saying it published it.
* The Like button is back on reels where HushGram's extra icons made the button column too tall. When a column runs past the top bar, HushGram's icons in it shrink a little from the next reel on. Reported in #676.
* The `Keep the comment bar's space` row now says it leaves a black band, reels from Explore included, and comes up when you search settings for "black bar". Turn it off and the reel fills that space. Reported in #680.
* A liked heart in Instagram's own red no longer has a thin light edge on a black page. With `Accent color` off, the outline under it is left out, as it already was for your accent color. Reported in #721.
* `Split the notes row` shows the Stories stack next to Instants and Notes on accounts where Instagram had left it out, with your friends' stories in it. Reported in #717.
* `Never save AV1 video`, `Never save HDR video` and `Save videos as MKV` go into a settings backup now, so restoring one brings them back with the other save switches. They used to come back off.
* `Hide Follow on posts` also catches the Follow button on a post you scroll to. `Hide captions`, `Hide the Like button`, `Hide the Save button`, `Hide the emoji row` and `Hide GIFs in comments` got the same fix. Reported in #719.
* `Below the Send message box` under `Seek bar position` now puts the story seek bar there on phones with little room under the box. The box moves up to make room. A keyboard still keeps the bar above it. Reported in #636.
* With `Stories fill the screen` on, a feed post reshared to a story keeps its whole frame like a shared reel does, so its sides aren't cut off once the video starts. Reported in #618.
* With `Stories fill the screen` on, a reel or post shared to a story keeps its whole frame now. A second layout pass right after was stretching it back over the whole screen and cutting its sides. Reported in #618.
* With `Hide the reply box on stories` or the Like, Comment and Share ones on, a story you open from its ring no longer shows those for a split second before they go. Reported in #618.
* `Ambient light` glows above and below a reel on the Reels tab and in reels opened from the feed again. Instagram 454 nests the reel deeper than the light was looking. Reported in #722.
* With `Rounded corners on Reels` on, `Ambient light` fills a reel's rounded corners too, so they show the glow instead of black. Reported in #722.
* A video's sound in your feed goes quiet while the HushGram settings are open, also when the restart button brings them back, and comes back when you close them. Reported in #725.
* `Story rings in the accent color` now reaches the rings on profiles, posts, chats and the newer Instagram screens. Only the few that read the theme took it before, and the rest kept Instagram's gradient. Reported in #528.
* A color picked in `Ring color` now shows on the story rings of Instagram's newer screens too, which kept the stock gradient. A ring color you pick still wins over `Story rings in the accent color`. Reported in #528.
* `Take a scroll break` remembers a running break and the minutes you've already used when Instagram is closed and opened again, or Android ends it in the background. Both used to start over. Reported in #297.
* `Stop after a set number of reels` keeps its count, and a stop it already reached, when Instagram is closed and opened again before the break is up.
* A wavy seek bar and its tall handle aren't cut flat along the top anymore once the controls dim on a reel. Reported in #450 and #586.
* With the tab bar hiding on Reels, a reel shorter than the screen sits where it would with the pill in place, instead of half the pill's height lower with more black above it. Reported in #450.
* `Show the whole reel` keeps a reel's top and bottom on a screen wider than the reel, like a tablet or an open foldable. Reported in #681.
* With `Keep a seek bar` on, a reel's seek bar moves along with the reel again. Sometimes the bar stayed at the start while the time above it counted up. Reported in #10.
* A photo reel with music gets its seek bar back after you hold it. It used to stay gone for the rest of that post. Reported in #10.
* `Download feed photos` saves a photo at the size it was posted, not the 1080 pixel copy. `Save photos at full size`, right under it, gets the original by reporting a big screen. Starts on. Needs a restart. Reported in #500.
* With `Swipe through a chat's reels` on, every reel you swipe to from a chat keeps its reply bar and reactions, answering its own message, and a second reel opened from the same chat does too. Reported in #658.
* `Messages after a reel` points out what the other person wrote after a reel again, whichever way the chat's reel was opened. Reported in #658.
* `Copy link` in the share sheet uses your `Sharing domain` again. The copied link had its tracking bits removed but still pointed at instagram.com. Reported in #667.
* In light mode the strips above and below a story, from a profile too, are black instead of white, so the clock and navigation buttons show again. `Ambient light in stories` glows on black there too. Reported in #666.
* With `Accent color` and `Icons in the accent color` on, the tab bar icons keep the picked color on Reels and after you leave it. They turned white on Reels and stayed white back on Home. Reported in #663.
* With `Accent color` and `Icons in the accent color` on, the comment, repost, share and save buttons under posts in Home take your color too. They stayed black, or white in dark mode. Reported in #724.
* Tapping a comment someone shared with you in a chat opens the reel it was on, not another reel that loaded first. It's part of `Open reel links on that reel`. Reported in #662.
* When Instagram itself lets you swipe through the reels a chat shared, with `Swipe through a chat's reels` off, a reply or reaction now goes to the reel you're watching, not the one you tapped. Reported in #662.
* With `Swipe through a chat's reels` on, tapping a comment shared in a chat opens the reel the comment is on. It used to start on the first unread reel the chat shared. Reported in #662.
* With `Glass tab bar` off, dragging along the lower edge of a reel's seek bar seeks again. That edge sits over the tab bar, so the drag used to press a tab or slide across the tabs instead. Reported in #526.
* The share sheet's Send button works on Reels again, and so does any other button over the tab bar. A tap there went to the reel's seek bar behind it. Swiping its app row no longer slides the tabs. Reported in #526.
* With a `Seek bar shape` picked, a reel's seek bar shows the whole shape. The wave and the tall handle got cut off at the top and bottom, and so did the bar while you held it. Reported in #450.
* With `See-through top bar` on, the frosted strip behind the status bar fades out into Home's feed once the top bar slides away. It ended in a hard line. Reported in #450.
* With `Page dots on a pill` and `Peek at the next carousel page` on, the pill stays at one height under a square or tall carousel's pages. It jumped up whenever you swiped to a video. Reported in #450.
* With `Glass tab bar` on, tapping a reel's More button or audio square right above the seek bar opens it again instead of seeking. Only a press on the bar itself goes to the seek bar now.
* With `Keep playing in the background` on, a video story that ends while Instagram is hidden plays the next story instead of stopping. Only one story plays at a time, and one you paused stays paused. Reported in #497.
* `Hide lives in Reels` also catches lives Instagram adds to the Reels tab after a page has loaded, including the ones it slips in one at a time after you've scrolled a while. Reported in #566.
* Tapping Stop on the background playback notification lets the video's player go once. If Instagram let it go during Stop's pause, HushGram let it go a second time.
* With `Keep playing in the background` on, a reel that hands over to the next one while Instagram is hidden lets go of the old player right away. The new one keeps playing.
* The glass tab bar costs less on Reels. It stopped asking for frames of its own between the reel's, and on Android 14 and newer copying the reel behind the pill no longer holds up the screen. Reported in #672.
* With `Badges in the accent color` on, the unread dot on the Primary and Requests chips at the top of Messages takes your accent color too. It kept Instagram's own color there. Reported in #671.
* With `Burn-in guard` set to `Dim when idle and shift`, the thin strip the screen leaves when it moves a step is black now. In light mode it showed as a white line along an edge. Reported in #669 and #703.
* `Swipe left to open the profile` works on reels opened outside the Reels tab, like from someone's profile, so hiding the Reels tab doesn't turn it off. A right swipe closes the profile. Reported in #596.
* With a floating `Glass tab bar` and three-button navigation, the pill stays above the buttons when you come back to Instagram from another screen. It could sink down into the navigation bar and stay there.
* Opening `Pause and diagnostics` on its own page no longer freezes Instagram. It hung whenever HushGram wasn't paused or locked.
* With `Pure black` and `Classic colors` or `Backgrounds in the accent color` both on in dark mode, the rows in a post's Likes list match the sheet behind them. They stayed black. Reported in #639.
* With `Lock your messages` on, `Double-tap Messages for hidden chats` works on the first try after Instagram starts. The lock dropped the second check, so the inbox opened with your hidden chats still hidden. Reported in #661.
* On fast phones, `Double-tap Messages for hidden chats` with `Lock your messages` on no longer loses its second tap to the fingerprint prompt. The locked inbox waits out the double-tap time before asking. Reported in #661.
* With `Hide the search bar` and `Hide group buttons` both on, the share sheet no longer leaves an empty band between its handle and the people grid. Reported in #685.
* With `Keep Home's top bar` on, the stories tray stays in the feed and scrolls away with your posts instead of sticking under the bar. Reported in #677.
* `Seek bar shape` keeps its own size on a `Thicker story progress bar`, the story bar glides while a video plays instead of stepping, and Instagram's own reel bar takes the shape too. Reported in #689.
* `Haptic strength` keeps growing past 150%, up to a long full-strength tap at 200%. Before, everything past 100% felt the same. Reported in #689.
* New switches show their blue dot again, right before the "i" that holds their description. Reported in #689.
* `Ambient light` now fills the black bands around a reel you open from a profile or the Reels tab. It used to light only a strip as wide as the spread. Reported in #689.
* `Find the reel you came from` works with `Keep the tab bar on a reel's profile` on. A profile opened on the tab never started the search, so the grid just stayed at the top. Reported in #693.
* A foldable's inner screen gets Instagram's own big screen layout again with `Glass tab bar` on. Tablets keep the phone layout so the glass shows, and `Phone layout on big screens` gives a fold the phone layout too. Reported in #695.
* A tablet turns with the device again while it shows the phone layout, from `Phone layout on big screens` or `Glass tab bar`. Instagram keeps its phone layout in portrait, so the tablet stayed stuck upright. Reported in #700 and #714.
* A reel's seek bar stays clear of the navigation bar after you leave Instagram and come back. It could drop behind it and stay there. Reported in #694 and #10.
* With a floating `Glass tab bar` and `Run Reels behind the tab bar` on, a reel's seek bar always rises above the pill. Sometimes it stayed behind the pill, out of reach. Reported in #704.
* The blur in a floating `Glass tab bar` keeps up with the reel behind it on Android 14 and newer. It only refreshed eight times a second before. A paused reel isn't copied over and over either. Reported in #583.
* On a wide reel with `Blur reel bars` on, the blur under the clock and tab bar now matches the blurred bars around the reel. It used to show a darker copy, with a line where they met. Reported in #584.
* `Save every page without asking` now covers a single photo with music in Reels and Explore too. The download icon saves the photo right away instead of asking video or photo. Asked for in #190.
* With `Backgrounds in the accent color` or `Classic colors` on in dark mode, the tab bar on Reels and the navigation bar under it match your other pages instead of going black, the glass pill included. Reported in #187.
* With `Backgrounds in the accent color` or `Classic colors` on, gray buttons like Edit profile and Share profile on your profile take a shade of the background color too. They kept Instagram's gray. Reported in #187.
* With `Accent color` on, the verified badge on a profile takes your color too, along with other icons that get their blue from a layout. It stayed blue. Reported in #187 and #721.
* With `Accent color` on in dark mode, the Older posts link above Home's suggested posts takes your color. It was still Instagram's light blue. Reported in #187.
* `Full screen Messages` hides the bars on your list of chats again. Instagram's newer messages list wasn't recognized, so only an open chat went full screen. Reported in #187.
* With `Accent color` on, the account switcher and Meta's other menus inside Instagram take your color instead of Meta's blue. With `Backgrounds in the accent color` or `Classic colors` on, their backgrounds match your pages too. Reported in #187.
* With `Keep playing` picked for `A tap on a reel`, a tap right on the play icon that shows up over the reel now pauses it. A tap anywhere else still keeps it playing. Reported in #554.

### Improvements

* HushGram now patches Instagram 455.0.0.51.72 instead of 454.0.0.54.77. Get APKMirror's (arm64-v8a) (480-640dpi) (Android 9.0+) bundle, build 386113969. Its armeabi-v7a (386113968), x86 (386113970) and x86_64 (386113971) builds are declared too.
* HushGram now patches Instagram 456.0.0.53.78 instead of 455.0.0.51.72. Get APKMirror's (arm64-v8a) (480dpi) (Android 9.0+) bundle, build 386214574. Its armeabi-v7a (386214562) and x86 (386214575) builds are declared too. Meta published no x86_64 build this time.
* HushGram now builds on Morphe patcher 2.4.0, so patching needs Morphe Manager 2.6.0 or newer. On a computer, use morphe-desktop 2.2.0 or newer.
* **Tooling:** The push gate starts its test suites without the git settings a hook hands them. Pushed from a second worktree, the release check's test had written its stand-in tag into the real repository. Nothing reached GitHub.
* **Tooling:** The test for `patch-for-device.ps1` caught up with the script merging a split bundle first. It now checks the merge reads the declared build's .apks and hands the CLI the merged APK.
* **Tooling:** Three contract rules had no fixture build that breaks them, so the contract test refused the file. They keep Instagram's code from calling clear mode's `entered()` and `scrubber()` or search's `hideSection()`. Each has a failing build now.

Puts a small HushGram badge on the second Instagram's home screen icon, so the two are easy to tell apart. Instagram's other icons you can pick in its settings get it too.

patches.name: Jump a profile's posts to a date
patches.description: Puts a calendar on a profile's top bar. Pick a day and the posts grid goes back to that day, with older posts as you scroll. Pull down for the newest again. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Keep Home's top bar
patches.description: Keeps the Instagram logo and the buttons beside it at the top of Home while you scroll. A second switch shows your feed blurred under them. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Keep Reels auto scroll on
patches.description: Keeps Instagram's auto scroll in Reels turned on after you leave Reels or restart Instagram, until you turn it off yourself. It can also move on to the next reel when one ends on accounts where Instagram doesn't offer auto scroll. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Keep a seek bar on Reels
patches.description: Keeps a seek bar under every reel, short ones too, with the time played and the reel's length above it, like 0:10 / 0:55. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Keep in chat
patches.description: Keeps view once and replayable photos and videos in your chats after you open them, so they don't disappear. A photo or video you send stays Instagram's own sent bubble. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Keep online history
patches.description: Keeps a list on your phone of when people in your messages came online and went offline, from the active status Instagram already shows. Nothing extra is asked of Instagram. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Keep photo locations from Instagram
patches.description: Stops Instagram from reading where the photos and videos in your gallery were taken. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches.name: Keep playing in the background
patches.description: A video or reel playing with sound keeps going when you leave Instagram or turn the screen off, with a notification to pause or stop it. Two more switches play reels or stories in a small window when you leave instead. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Keep stories playing while zooming
patches.description: Keeps a story playing while you pinch to zoom it, instead of pausing it. A story you hold still first stays paused. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Keep story buttons below the story
patches.description: With a large font or display size, the reply box and buttons along the bottom of a story move down into the empty space under it instead of covering the story. Starts on. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Keep story viewers
patches.description: Keeps a list on your phone of who viewed each of your stories, from the viewer list Instagram already shows you, and sets it beside your followers. Nothing extra is asked of Instagram. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Keep the Reels top bar
patches.description: Keeps the Reels title, the Friends tab and the buttons beside them at the top while you swipe through reels. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Keep the reel speed
patches.description: Keeps the 2x speed on for the next reels after you lock a reel at 2x (hold its edge, then slide down), until you slide the lock off. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Keep the tab bar on a reel's profile
patches.description: A profile you open from a reel stays on the tab you're on, with the tab bar under it. Back goes back to the reel. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Keep your place in Home
patches.description: Coming back to Instagram leaves Home on the post you were on, however long you were away, instead of reloading it and jumping to the top. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Let the screen sleep when a reel stops
patches.description: Instagram keeps the screen on while Reels is open, even with a reel paused. With this on, a paused reel lets your phone's screen timeout run, and a playing one keeps the screen on. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Lock your messages
patches.description: Covers your inbox and chats, all of Instagram, or just the single chats you pick under Locked chats, until your fingerprint, face or screen lock says it's you. Message notifications only say that a message came. Chats you pick under Hidden chats leave your inbox and their notifications don't post. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Long press to zoom
patches.description: Press and hold a photo in a feed to see it twice as big around your finger, and let go to close it. Pinch to zoom still works. Keep the zoom open leaves it up after you let go, to drag and pinch from 1x to 4x until a tap or Back closes it. Long press a post for full screen opens any photo or video on black instead, a video with a slider. While its switch is on, each takes the place of Instagram's own long press. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Loop a story
patches.description: Plays a story again from the start when it ends, instead of moving on to the next one. Tap or swipe to move on. With it off, Loop this story in a story's menu loops just that one. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Mark one-time photos and videos
patches.description: Puts a border and Instagram's own view once icon on a one-time photo or video in a chat, so you can tell it before you open it. Only how the chat looks changes. Nothing is saved, replayed, marked seen or sent. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Message box buttons
patches.description: Lets you take the gallery, sticker and voice message buttons off the message box of a chat, and keep the text box and Send. Starts with every button showing. Pick which to hide in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Open comments without the keyboard
patches.description: Comments open with the keyboard down. A tap in the comment box, or on Reply, still brings it up. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.

patches.name: Open links in external browser
patches.description: Opens web links you tap in your usual browser instead of Instagram's built-in one, without Instagram's click tracker. Ads and Meta's own sites (Instagram, Facebook, Messenger, Threads) still open in the app. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches.name: Open reel links on that reel
patches.description: A reel link opens on the reel it points to, instead of another reel Instagram kept on your phone playing first. Starts on. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Phone layout on big screens
patches.description: On a foldable or tablet, Instagram keeps its phone layout across the whole screen, with the tab bar at the bottom instead of down the side. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches.name: Pick the app icon
patches.description: Lets you pick the icon Instagram shows on your home screen: Instagram's own, HushGram's, Instagram's glyph on black, on plum, or in black on white, a hand-drawn Instagram glyph on white, Instagram's gradient glyph on dark, the old retro camera icon, or Instagram's glyph in pink on pale pink. The new icon shows once you leave Instagram, and you may need to add it to your home screen again from the app drawer. Starts on Instagram's own. Pick one in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches.name: Pinch to zoom on Reels
patches.description: Lets you zoom into a playing reel with two fingers, the way a photo zooms. Lift your fingers and it goes back. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Preview chats
patches.description: Long press a chat in your messages and tap Preview to read its newest messages without opening it, so nobody sees Seen. You can reply from there too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages. Either way, a chat's menu opens above the chat when it wouldn't fit between the chat and the tab bar.

patches.name: Profile posts as a list
patches.description: Opening someone's profile takes you on to their posts as a scrolling list of full posts. Back shows the grid. Your own profile keeps its grid. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Pure black dark mode
patches.description: Makes Instagram's dark mode pure black instead of dark gray, on the menus that slide up from the bottom, the one you get by holding a message or a chat, the one the + in a chat opens, and the notes above your chats too. It looks deeper and can save battery on an OLED screen. Buttons keep their grays so they stay easy to see. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Read messages without the seen receipt
patches.description: Opening a chat no longer tells people you've seen their messages. You still see when they've seen yours. Mark as read, or the check mark at the top of a chat, still tells them. With `Choose Seen in each chat` on, an eye at the top of each chat holds or sends Seen in that chat alone, whichever way the main switch is. Ghost mode turns it on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Remove build expired popup
patches.description: Stops Instagram from locking you out with a screen that says this version is too old. A patched build can't update itself, so it would stop working after a few weeks. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Version warnings.

patches.name: Remove the advertising ID
patches.description: Stops Instagram from reading your phone's advertising ID, which ad companies use to follow you between apps. Instagram gets a string of zeros instead. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Remove the empty space at the bottom
patches.description: Takes away the empty gap Instagram leaves under its tab bar for a navigation bar that isn't there. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches.name: Restore trust on re-signed builds
patches.description: Lets Instagram's own checks of who signed the app pass on a patched build, so the parts that need them keep working. Threads, Facebook and Messenger patched with the same key work too. Facebook login goes through your browser instead of the Facebook app, which turns a patched Instagram away. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Resume long videos
patches.description: A video or reel longer than two minutes picks up where you left off the next time you play it on the same account. Live videos and ads start as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Rounded post corners
patches.description: Rounds the corners of a post's photo, video and carousel pages in Home and Following, and of reels and stories if you like, at a small or large size. Profiles and Explore stay as Instagram draws them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches.description: Removes tracking tags from the links you copy or share, and opens bio links without Instagram's click tracker. The link still opens the same post, reel, story or profile. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches.name: Save comment photo
patches.description: Adds Save to the menu you get by pressing and holding a comment that has its own photo, GIF or sticker, saving the largest size Instagram sent. A GIF or sticker is saved as a .gif in Pictures/Instagram, taken from Instagram's own copy, not Giphy. If Instagram lists only an animated WebP or an MP4 for it, you get that file instead, and an MP4 goes in Movies/Instagram like a video. It can also add a GIF reply to a comment with a GIF, sending that same GIF back as your reply, or show a comment GIF's or sticker's name in that menu. A GIF it saved, picked again from your gallery in a comment, goes up animated instead of as a still. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.

patches.name: Save in the post menu
patches.description: Adds Save to the menu behind the three dots on posts in your feed, and switches that take the Save button, the Like button, the counts or the "Liked by" line off them. Starts off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Save profile picture
patches.description: Adds Save profile picture, View profile picture, Copy username and Copy bio to the menu on someone's profile. View opens the picture full screen and lets you zoom. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Downloads.

patches.name: Saved on your profile
patches.description: Adds a bookmark to the tabs on your own profile, beside posts, reels and tagged, that opens Saved on All, a handle to drag through Saved and your collections, and a switch that hides the + for a new collection. All start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Profiles. The bookmark needs an Instagram restart.

patches.name: Search blocked accounts
patches.description: Adds a search box above your blocked accounts that finds them by username or name. While you type, the rest of your list loads page by page, and a line under the box says how many matched out of how many loaded. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches.name: Search comments
patches.description: Adds a search box above a post's comments. Type a word or a name and the comments scroll to the next one that has it, loading more as they go. The arrows step forward and back through the matches. Replies you haven't opened aren't searched. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.

patches.name: See who a story mentions
patches.description: Adds a small label in a story's header showing how many accounts it mentions. Tap it for a list and tap an account to open their profile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Seek bar on feed videos
patches.description: Shows a bar along the bottom of the video playing in your feed that you can drag to jump to any point in it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed. Another switch there adds a small button on the video that shows or hides the bar, and a choice under it makes the bar see-through or puts it on frosted glass. Another puts the bar right on the video's bottom edge, where a scroll is less likely to catch it. One more lets a double tap on the left or right side of the video go back or ahead 10 seconds, while the middle still likes the post, and the arrows it flashes can be turned off. Two more choose a shape for every seek bar, story progress segments and videos in chats included, and show a preview above your finger while you drag one. Feed videos can also get a shape of their own, and the time over the bar, which a tap flips to the time left.

patches.name: Seek bar on stories
patches.description: Shows a bar near the bottom of a video story that you can drag to jump to any point in the video. Photos don't get one. A choice under it makes the bar see-through or puts it on frosted glass, and another moves it into the space under the Send message box. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Sent follow requests
patches.description: Keeps a list of the accounts you've asked to follow that haven't let you in yet, with their pictures and names. A tap opens the profile, where Instagram's own Requested button cancels the request. It lists the requests a follow button shows while it's on. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Shorter Active now
patches.description: Someone shows as Active now for one minute after they leave, like on the website, instead of six and a half. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Show a post's exact time
patches.description: Shows the date and time a post went up, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, instead of how long ago. It does the same for comments. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Show a reel's exact time
patches.description: Adds the date and time a reel was posted under the author's name, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, with the seconds or how long ago (1d 2h 5m ago) if you want them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Show a story's exact time
patches.description: Shows the date and time a story was posted, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, instead of how long ago. A choice under the switch can show the time left instead. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Show all recent searches
patches.description: Lists every recent search under the search bar instead of the first few. See all and the x on each row work as before. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Explore.

patches.name: Show hidden like counts
patches.description: Shows how many likes a post or reel has when its owner hid the count, as long as Instagram's server still sends the number. If it doesn't, nothing changes. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Show if a profile follows you
patches.description: Adds Follows you or Doesn't follow you beside the name on someone's profile. Other switches add a chip and mark accounts on your Following list that don't follow you back, in words or as a red cross on the profile picture with a green check for those that do, and Recent unfollowers shows who left your Followers list, with a Follower history of who left, came back or is new. The chip is blue for Follows you, green for Following each other and red for Doesn't follow you, and it can go small under the profile picture. Tap the chip to see the rest of what Instagram says about you two, like Close Friends, Favorites, mutes, restrictions and pending follow requests. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Show when someone was last active
patches.description: Shows the exact time someone was last on, like Active at 3:42 PM, in your messages and in a chat, instead of Active 3h ago. Active now stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Skip the ad data reminder
patches.description: Stops Instagram's reminder to review whether it can process your data for ads from opening by itself. Your ad choice doesn't change and nothing is answered for you. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches.name: Skip the collections tray
patches.description: Saving a post or reel shows Instagram's Saved message instead of the tray that asks you to start a collection. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Skip the contacts and location popups
patches.description: Stops the screens asking you to sync your contacts and turn on location services from opening each time Instagram starts. Nothing else is skipped. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches.name: Smooth story opening
patches.description: Opens a story from the stories row with a slower, gentler zoom instead of Instagram's quick spring. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Sort reels on profiles
patches.description: Brings back the arrow next to Reels on a profile, with Latest and Most viewed, on profiles where Instagram took it away. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Speed button on stories
patches.description: Puts a speed button at the top of a video story. Tap it to play the story at 1.5x or 2x, and later video stories keep that speed. Photos and ads play as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Split the notes row
patches.description: Splits the row of notes at the top of your messages into three stacks, Instants, Notes and Stories, the layout Instagram is trying out. It takes a restart. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Spoof location
patches.description: Tells Instagram your phone is at a place you pick, for the location sticker, nearby places and maps. Photos keep their own places. You need to pick a place too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches.name: Start Home on Following
patches.description: Opens Home on posts from accounts you follow instead of For you. A second switch removes For you from Home, and a third keeps Instagram's logo at the top of Home in place of the feed's name. A fourth, Fall back to Following, opens Home on Following for an account whose For you brings only suggested posts, unless you picked a feed. A fifth, Mix in Following, shows a page of posts from accounts you follow after each page of For you. Restart Instagram to see the change. Keep the tab bar on Favorites leaves Search and Messages a tap away there, and a tab you choose can open Favorites with a long press. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Start feed videos with sound
patches.description: Starts videos on Home with their sound on, the same as tapping a video's speaker, or keeps them muted while reels play with sound. Your phone's ringer and volume still count. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Start on x86 devices
patches.description: Stops Instagram from crashing or freezing on x86 devices that run its code through a translator, such as some Chromebooks and emulators. Phones and tablets with arm chips run it as before. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Start reels with sound
patches.description: A reel you open from the Reels tab, a profile or a post on Home plays with sound, and Home is muted again when you go back. Your phone's ringer and volume still count. A separate switch, Start reels muted, starts every reel silent instead. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Start stories with sound
patches.description: Opens stories with their sound on, the same as tapping Instagram's speaker. Your phone's ringer and volume still count. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Stop Reels scrolling
patches.description: Stops a swipe in Reels from moving to the next reel, so you stay on the one you opened, with switches that leave reels from a profile, Search and Explore or a song page free to scroll. Play only the reel you opened does the same, auto scroll included, for reels you open from a post on Home, a suggested reels row or a message, and leaves the Reels tab alone. Another switch stops swiping after as many reels as you pick, for as long as you pick, and Take a scroll break covers Home, Reels and Explore for 5 minutes after the time you pick. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Stop Story auto-advance
patches.description: Keeps each story on screen until you tap or swipe. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Stop background wake-ups
patches.description: Stops three things that wake your phone while Instagram is in the background. One alarm goes off every minute or two only to note that Instagram is still running, another wakes it five minutes later to upload usage events, and a job about every half hour downloads your feed ahead of time. Messages and notifications still arrive. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Battery.

patches.name: Stop swipe to create
patches.description: Stops a sideways swipe on Home from opening the camera, or from opening Messages. The + and Messages buttons still work. It can also open Messages when you swipe left on Home, like Instagram used to. All start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Stop swipe up to reply
patches.description: Stops a swipe up on someone's story from opening the reply box and its reactions. Tapping Send message still replies. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Stop swiping between tabs
patches.description: Stops a sideways swipe from moving between Home, Reels and the other main tabs. Tapping the tab bar still works. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Stop videos looping
patches.description: Feed videos and reels stop at their last frame instead of playing again. Reels still loop while auto scroll is on, so it can move on. Loop this video in a video's menu loops that one anyway. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Stories priority
patches.description: Puts the accounts on your list first in the stories row at the top of Home while they have a story you haven't watched. Starts off. Turn it on and type the accounts in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Story ring size
patches.description: Draws the rings in the stories row at the top of Home smaller, so more fit on screen, or larger, the ring of a story you haven't watched in a color you pick, and story rings thinner or thicker. Another switch takes the rings off profile pictures everywhere else, like posts, comments, reels and profiles. Nothing changes until you pick a size, a color or a thickness or turn that switch on. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Story text fonts
patches.description: Adds fonts you pick from your phone (.ttf or .otf files) to the story text editor alongside Instagram's own fonts, and can draw the emoji in story text from an emoji font file you pick. Starts off. Set both up in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Swipe left to open the profile
patches.description: Makes a left swipe on a reel open the profile of the person who posted it, like Instagram used to. Tap Friends at the top to reach your friends' reels. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Swipe through a chat's photos and posts
patches.description: Open a photo, video or shared post from a chat and swipe up through the chat's other photos, videos and shared posts, in chat order. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Swipe through a chat's reels
patches.description: Swiping up on a reel you opened from a chat goes through the other reels shared in that chat before any suggested reels, can stop after them and can leave out the ones you sent. All start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Tab bar layout
patches.description: Lets you keep the newer tab bar, where you swipe between every tab, or the classic one, instead of the one Instagram picks for your account. Starts on Instagram's choice. Pick one in HushGram settings > Tab bar.

patches.name: Tap a feed video to pause it
patches.description: A tap on the video playing in a feed pauses it in place instead of opening it in Reels, and another tap plays it again. Ads keep Instagram's own tap. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed. Another switch there stops any tap on a feed video from opening Reels, with or without the pause.

patches.name: Tap to play
patches.description: Makes videos, reels and stories wait for your tap instead of starting by themselves, like Instagram does when it saves mobile data. A choice under the switch picks where: Reels, Explore, both, or everything but them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Thicker story progress bar
patches.description: Draws the progress bar along the top of a story twice or three times as thick. Its segments and timing stay as they were. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Three-dot menu items
patches.description: Lets you leave Report, Mute and other items out of the menus behind the three dots on posts, reels and stories. Every item shows until you untick it in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Turn off HDR brightness boosts
patches.description: Stops HDR photos and reels from making the screen brighter than everything else. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Turn off double tap to like
patches.description: Stops a double tap on a post or reel from liking it, and the heart doesn't show. The Like button still works. Separate switches cover posts, reels, comments and chat messages. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Upload stories at full quality
patches.description: Sends the video stories you post at 1080p and a higher bitrate, as Instagram does with its own Upload at highest quality setting on. Choices under it can cover posts and reels too and ask for a bitrate up to 50 Mbps, up to 2160p and 120 fps where your phone's video encoder can take them, or a higher photo quality and size. Instagram still shrinks story videos to 720p on its servers, so viewers see a small difference. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Use the highest refresh rate
patches.description: Asks Android to run Instagram at your screen's fastest refresh rate, at the same resolution, so scrolling looks smoother on a 90 or 120 Hz phone. Some phones keep their own limit for apps. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches.name: View DM photos and videos anonymously
patches.description: Holds back the Opened notice for view once photos and videos in messages, so the sender doesn't see you opened them. Ghost mode turns it on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches.name: View live anonymously
patches.description: Keeps you off the viewer list of the lives you watch, so the host isn't told you're there. Your own lives still count their viewers. An optional eye button at the top of a live puts you on that one's list. Ghost mode turns it on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: View stories anonymously
patches.description: Keeps you off the viewer list of the stories you watch. Replying or reacting still shows you. An optional Mark as seen button lets you choose. Ghost mode turns it on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Watch again in the feed
patches.description: When a reel in your feed ends, Watch again plays it over right there instead of opening it in Reels, and Hide Watch more reels takes the other button off that card. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Feed.

release_notes:
HushGram now patches Instagram 456.0.0.53.78 and builds on Morphe patcher 2.4.0, so update Morphe Manager to 2.6.0 or newer before you patch. All 62 new features in this release came from your requests. You can keep a list of who viewed your stories, search your blocked accounts, give the tab bar a Material look or make Instagram's text bigger. The fix list is a long one too.

New in this release

- A saved profile can sit in more than one folder now. Save profile lists your folders with tick boxes, and a long press in `Your saved profiles` offers `Choose folders`. Settings exports keep every folder. Asked for in #687.

- `Long press a profile picture to view it`, new under Profiles, opens the picture at the top of a profile at full size, with Save under it. A tap still does what it always did. Starts off. Asked for in #737.

- `Download full song`, new under Reels, adds a row under Download on reels and photos with Instagram music. It saves the whole song instead of the reel's clip, and `Ask what to save` offers it too. Starts off. Asked for in #735.

- `Hide the top bar on other reels`, new under Reels, takes the back arrow and title off reels you open from Explore, a profile, a post, Saved or a chat. The back gesture still works. Starts off. Asked for in #680.

- `Search blocked accounts`, new under Ads and privacy, adds a search box to your blocked accounts that finds them by username or name. Long lists load as you type, with a count of matches. Starts off. Asked for in #731.

- `Hide the Messages badge`, new under Tab bar, takes the unread count off the Messages button in the bottom bar. Chats still show as unread in your inbox and notifications still come. It starts off and takes a restart. Asked for in #734.

- `Don't send feed view history`, new under Feed, stops Instagram from learning which Home posts you looked at, like `Don't send reel watch history` does for Reels. Seen posts may come back. Ghost mode turns it on too. Starts off. Asked for in #664.

- `Ask for VP9 instead of AV1`, new under Downloads, tells Instagram your phone has no AV1 decoder, so reels and stories come as VP9 or H.264. It helps when AV1 saves won't play in your gallery. Asked for in #546.

- `Keep story viewers`, new under Stories, keeps a list on your phone of who viewed each of your stories. Its page shows who viewed over a week, month or 90 days and who views most. Asked for in #710.

- `Keep online history`, new under Profiles, keeps a list on your phone of when people in your messages came online and went offline, from the active status Instagram already shows. Asked for in #590.

- `Glass lens under your finger`, new in Tab bar, makes the `Liquid glass look` bubble swell and bend what's behind it under your finger. The bend needs `Blur behind the tab bar` and Android 13 or newer. Starts off. Asked for in #705.

- `Cache size limit`, a slider under `Clear the media cache` in Storage, sets how much room Instagram's saved photos and videos can take, from 100 MB to 4,000 MB. It starts at 500 MB like before. Asked for in #713.

- `Save changed pictures to the gallery`, under `Keep profile history` in Profiles, saves both the old and the new picture when a profile you open has changed it. Each picture is saved once. Starts off. Asked for in #715.

- Tap the `Show it as a chip` chip on a profile to see everything else Instagram says about you two, like a pending follow request, Close Friends, Favorites, a restriction, a block, a hidden story or a mute. Asked for in #698.

- `Tabs on your profile` and `Tabs on other profiles` under Profiles can take a creator's Subscriptions tab off too, along with Reels, Reposts and Tagged. Asked for in #721.

- `Hide rings outside the stories row`, under `Story ring size` in Stories, takes the story and live rings off profile pictures on posts, comments, reels and profiles. The pictures stay, and so do the rings in the stories row. Asked for in #719.

- Each number beside a reel can go on its own now. Five new switches under Reels, `Hide like counts on reels` through `Hide save counts on reels`, each take one count away and leave its button. Asked for in #719.

- `Material look`, under Glass tab bar in Tab bar, gives the floating tab bar Android's Material 3 style, a solid round pill in your phone's colors on Android 12 and newer. It needs `Liquid glass look` off. Asked for in #720.

- `Start feed videos muted`, under Feed, keeps videos on Home quiet even after you turn the sound on in Reels, so reels keep theirs. Tap a video's speaker to hear that one. Asked for in #718.

- `Double tap to skip` on Reels flashes arrows and the seconds skipped on the side you tapped, like it already does on feed videos. `Show the skip arrows`, right under it, turns them off. Asked for in #691.

- Quick double taps the same way now add up under the skip arrows on Reels and feed videos, so three skips ahead read 10, 20 and then 30. Asked for in #554.

- `Hide the seek bar on reels`, new under Reels, takes the seek bar off every reel. Drag sideways along a reel's bottom edge to bring it back and seek, even where Instagram turns that off. Needs a restart. Asked for in #680.

- `Hide the pause icon on reels` under Reels keeps a paused reel clear of the big pause icon and its sound button, so the frame you stopped on stays in view. A tap still plays it. Asked for in #686.

- `Hide the Like button on reels` and `Hide the Comment button on reels` under Reels, and `Hide the Like button` under Feed, take those buttons and their counts away. Double tap still likes. Asked for in #668.

- `Ask before a refresh` also asks when you tap Home, Reels or Explore while you're already on it, since that tap scrolls back to the top and reloads too. Cancel leaves the list where it was. Asked for in #655.

- HushGram's own settings screen uses the font you pick in `Change the font` too, headings and switch labels included. Its popups follow it as well, like the "i" descriptions, pickers and PIN prompts. Asked for in #166.

- A new switch, `Hide You may also like in search` under Explore, takes the You may also like posts and their title off the bottom of search results. Accounts and the posts you searched for stay. Asked for in #657.

- `Play only the reel you opened` under Reels keeps a reel you open from a Home post, a suggested reels row or a message on screen, so it loops instead of moving on. The Reels tab scrolls as usual. Asked for in #656.

- `Auto scroll in Home` under Feed moves Home to the next post by itself, when a video ends or after the time you pick for photos and carousels. Touching the screen holds it. Asked for in #660.

- `Swipe left for Messages`, new under Feed, opens Messages when you swipe left across Home, the way Instagram used to. Carousels and the stories row still slide as before. It starts off. Asked for in #639.

- `Hide links`, new with the other profile banner switches under Profiles, takes the row of links (a website or a business's links) from under the bio on other people's profiles. Yours keeps it. Asked for in #627.

- `Send saved GIFs as GIFs`, new under Comments, posts a GIF you saved with `Save comment photo` as a GIF when you pick it from your gallery in a comment. Instagram sent it as a still. Asked for in #402.

- `Hide Blend in chats` and `Hide the back button in chats`, new under Messages, take those buttons off a chat's top bar. Swiping back still leaves the chat. Asked for in #688.

- `Top bar tint in chats` and `Message bar tint`, new under `Glass in chats`, set how dark each glass bar is, from 0% (blur only) to 150%. The tab bar keeps its own tint. Asked for in #688.

- `Header text font` picks bold, regular, serif, script, monospace or your `Font` choice for the words on Home's header, and `Center the header text` puts them in the middle of the screen. Asked for in #688.

- With `Glass in chats` on, messages scroll under a chat's top bar and show through it blurred, and the blur runs up behind the status bar with a soft fade at its edge. Asked for in #684.

- `Story buttons at the bottom`, new under Stories, puts the seen and download buttons at the bottom right of a story, by your thumb, next to Like. Asked for in #647.

- `Text size`, new under `Font`, sets Instagram's text anywhere from 70% to 200% of the phone's size, in any font. Asked for in #682.

Behind the scenes

- The push gate starts its test suites without the git settings a hook hands them. Pushed from a second worktree, the release check's test had written its stand-in tag into the real repository. Nothing reached GitHub.

- The test for `patch-for-device.ps1` caught up with the script merging a split bundle first. It now checks the merge reads the declared build's .apks and hands the CLI the merged APK.

- Three contract rules had no fixture build that breaks them, so the contract test refused the file. They keep Instagram's code from calling clear mode's `entered()` and `scrubber()` or search's `hideSection()`. Each has a failing build now.

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Update Morphe Manager to 2.6.0 or newer, then refresh the HushGram source.
2. Patch Instagram `456.0.0.53.78`. [Supported Instagram builds](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram#supported-instagram-builds) lists the builds that work.
3. Install over your current patched Instagram with the manager's existing signing key. Keep that key so updates keep working.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not an Instagram APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram#install).
